clusters.title: MI325→MI300 runner-swap GPU out-of-resources (`HSA OUT_OF_RESOURCES`, `Free mem 0 MB`)

details.label: Status
details.text: NEW today, first observed 2026-07-29 in the **in-flight** run [30477397236](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30477397236) (the two jobs concluded `failure`). `test_piecewise_cuda_graph_support_1_gpu.py` passed on every prior mi325 run and fails on the first mi300 run.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` runner-swap [#31409](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31409) ([`bfc450248`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/bfc450248efe06af2853464d390021d6d8bbf4ce), merged 2026-07-29 15:18 UTC — ancestor of the failing run) moved `stage-b/stage-c` rocm720 shards to `linux-mi300` (smaller HBM than MI325 at `mem_fraction_static=0.862`), so the high-concurrency GSM8K decode (~974–1024 reqs) exhausts device memory → scheduler SIGABRT (−6). **Disconfirming**: the DSV3.2 8-TP OOM also reproduced once on mi325 (Jul-24 @61%, 2/8 runs), so that leg is partly flaky-independent of the swap; MI300/MI325 are both gfx942 and per-device free-VRAM at launch was not captured.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none targeting the OOM. Related (not fixes): [#32003](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32003) (route to MI300 w/ model cache), [#28584](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28584) (WIP), [#27227](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27227) (revert mi325 pin).

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: A/B `--mem-fraction-static` (e.g. 0.80) on the mi300 pool and/or lower GSM8K `num_threads`; if the score returns to ~0.82, add a per-runner memory-fraction override for the mi300 matrix; else coordinate a re-pin with the [#31409](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31409) authors. Re-run the two shards 3–5× to separate swap-OOM from the pre-existing DSV3.2 flake.
